name: Tactics Playbook 3rd-Year Edition
effect: Passing the Torch targets up to 2 team members, including Suga. If initiating, grants Spd+5 and Pow/Def/Rec+3.

name: Rookie Pains & Rookie Gains
effect: Deals bonus damage equal to 15% of Qik. If initiating, grants Qik/Spd+5. If faster, neutralizes guaranteed foe follow-ups and effects preventing unit follow-ups; when initiating, foe cannot counterattack.

name: The Pursuit of the "Out of Nowhere"
effect: At start of turn 1, grants cooldown count−2. Gains Jmp equal to 70% of Spd bonuses, with no cap. If initiating, grants Pow/Def+5.

name: A Mediocre Mountain Climber's Chalk
effect: Grants all base stats+2. If initiating, grants Pow/Spd+5. After combat, grants all combat stats+4 to unit and allies. If Ultimate triggered, cleanses unit and same-row allies.
